primaryGoal: Witness AI development through 99 playable browser-game experiments.
notTheGoal: This is not a rushed attempt to mass-produce 99 AI-made games.
archiveMethod: Playable game experiments with provenance, model variants, run records, and curator notes.
mission: A long-term AI game-making evolution archive where playable browser games act as observation samples.
maintainerRole: The maintainer curates prompts, tests builds, publishes games, and documents provenance without hand-editing game code.

slotVariantRunPolicy.summary: The 99 game slots represent 99 observation samples, not 99 AI generations.
slotVariantRunPolicy.gameSlot: One official playable experiment in the AI evolution archive.
slotVariantRunPolicy.modelVariant: A version of the same game concept made by a specific model or agent. Variants do not consume additional game numbers.
slotVariantRunPolicy.runRecord: One generation, revision, validation, or comparison attempt for a game or variant. Run records can grow indefinitely.

games.title: Lumen Lattice
games.archiveRole: First Puzzle Logic Hall observation sample
games.description: Lumen Lattice: Prism Archive is a PC-first constraint logic puzzle. Each press sends light through a fixed pattern (pulse, beam, or split) that flips a set of prisms. Every lattice is reverse-scrambled from a solved board, so each puzzle is guaranteed solvable, with tracked-parity hint and autoSolve.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: PC-first benchmark tuned for keyboard and mouse at 1440x900 and 1920x1080. Mobile is baseline playable: the square board scales to width, prisms are tap targets, and the tools stay reachable, but larger lattices read more comfortably on desktop. Checked in local browser device-emulation viewports only; no physical handset QA is claimed.

provenance.notes: Model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. Current canonical source is the Prism Archive remake (variant claude-lumen-lattice-prism-archive-2026-06-03, 2026-06-03), authored by Claude Code under the no-human-code-edits rule. The original variant and all prior run records are preserved, not deleted.

games.mediaNote: Screenshot files predate the Prism Archive remake (captured from variant claude-opus-4-8-2026-05-31) and are stale; kept as history. Real Prism Archive screenshots are pending maintainer browser QA and are not claimed to reflect the current build.
games.repositoryNote: Observation 002 / Game 002. Puzzle Logic Hall benchmark. Current canonical source is the PC-first Prism Archive remake; the original variant and its run records are preserved.

games.title: Ninefold Draft
games.archiveRole: First Card Strategy Hall observation sample
games.description: A PC-first card strategy benchmark. Across eight cycles you draft one protocol per cycle, build a small engine, and manage Energy, Focus, and Integrity to reach an Alignment objective against a telegraphed hazard track. The draft offers and hazard order are deterministic, so the run is decided by strategy.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: PC-first card strategy benchmark designed for mouse and keyboard at 1440x900 and 1920x1080. Mobile is a no-overflow baseline only: the layout reflows cards to fewer columns to avoid horizontal overflow and the cards stay tappable, but the multi-zone board is intended for desktop. Interactive browser smoke and physical handset QA are pending and not claimed.

provenance.notes: Model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. The game, its deterministic draft and hazard system, and its scoring were authored by Claude Code under the no-human-code-edits project rule.

games.repositoryNote: Observation 004 / Game 004. First Card Strategy Hall benchmark: deterministic drafting, turn structure, resource trade-offs, and readable strategy.

games.title: Gravity Atlas
games.archiveRole: First Physics Experiment Hall observation sample
games.description: A PC-first deterministic physics puzzle. Drag from the launch pad to aim and fire a probe across six gravity plates, curving its path through masses, repulsors, and void zones into the target ring within each plate's shot budget. A committed Node verifier replays embedded reference launch vectors through the same engine the browser runs, proving every plate is completable.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: PC-first physics benchmark tuned for mouse aiming at 1440x900 and 1920x1080. Mobile is a no-overflow baseline: the 16:9 plate scales to width and drag-aiming works as a touch gesture, but fine trajectory control is intended for a mouse. Interactive browser smoke and physical handset QA are pending and not claimed.

provenance.notes: Model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. The deterministic physics engine, plate designs, embedded reference solutions, and the standing Node verifier were authored by Claude Code under the no-human-code-edits project rule.

games.repositoryNote: Observation 005 / Game 005. First Physics Experiment Hall benchmark: simulation feel, spatial reasoning, cause/effect readability, and a machine-verifiable completability proof.

games.title: Afterlight Dispatch
games.archiveRole: First Text Adventure Hall observation sample
games.description: A deterministic branching radio narrative about guiding a flooded city's last rescue network through six transmissions. Choices alter later calls, public promises return as state, evidence supports or contradicts the final route, and a pure shared engine makes every ending reproducible.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: Responsive controls and a single-column layout support a 390px browser-emulation baseline. The narrative remains playable by touch, but the carrier map and persistent transcript are more legible on desktop; no physical handset QA is claimed.

provenance.notes: Initial canonical implementation for Observation 007 / Game 007. The model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. Game code, deterministic narrative engine, metadata, verification, screenshots, and documentation were generated by Codex under the no-human-code-edits project rule.

games.repositoryNote: Observation 007 / Game 007. First Text Adventure Hall benchmark: branching narrative, state memory, tone, meaningful choices, and a machine-verifiable successful route.

games.title: Deepforge Miner
games.archiveRole: DeepSeek v4 Pro incremental economy observation sample
games.description: A space mining incremental clicker game. Click the asteroid to mine ore, purchase automated drones, upgrade through pickaxe to quantum extractor, unlock new asteroid fields with rare resources, and prestige for permanent bonuses. Canvas-rendered with particle effects, orbiting drone animations, floating damage numbers, and expanding click rings.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: Desktop-first clicker tuned for mouse and keyboard at 1280x720 and above. Mobile baseline supports loading, no horizontal overflow, tap-to-mine on the canvas, and tappable action buttons, but rapid clicking and fine UI are intended for desktop. No physical handset QA is claimed.

games.title: Resonance Loom
games.archiveRole: GLM-5.2 Web Audio rhythm observation sample
games.description: A four-lane browser rhythm game where D, F, J, and K keystrokes or lane taps weave a live-synthesized melody. Three original note charts use Web Audio oscillators with no samples or external dependencies, while timing judgements, combo scoring, grades, and local high scores reward precision.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: The responsive layout and lane taps support a 390px browser viewport, but rhythm timing is designed primarily for desktop keyboard play. No physical handset QA is claimed.

provenance.notes: The supplied package declares GLM-5.2 by Z.ai as the author of all game source. The original source metadata is preserved as source-game.json; archive metadata and generated publishing assets were added during integration without changing gameplay, charts, or audio logic.

games.mediaNote: The title-screen image is a real local browser capture. The cover poster and social card are promotional artwork, not gameplay evidence.
